data.narrative:
Stellaria is a seed-stage nuclear energy company that has raised €23M to date, with backing from CEA and Schneider Electric under the leadership of CEO Nicolas Breyton. The nuclear energy sector comp universe consists of 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy.

Peer-median valuation triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable data within the nuclear energy subsector; only 1 same-stage peer and 1 adjacent-stage peer were identified, falling short of the 3-minimum threshold required for robust peer analysis. Consequently, stage-progression methodology was applied as the primary valuation anchor. Using total raised ($23M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $58M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $49M to $66M, with a median point of $58M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Primary uncertainties stem from the nascent stage of the nuclear energy venture market, which limits direct peer comparables, and from inherent variability in seed-stage step-up multiples across frontier-tech subsectors. The current limited dataset warrants reassessment as additional nuclear energy financing rounds occur.
